title: The Milkmaid Secret That Beat Smallpox

sections.name: The Milkmaid Secret That Beat Smallpox
lines: In the 1700s, smallpox was one of the deadliest diseases on Earth. But milkmaids seemed to be safe from it.
Country doctor Edward Jenner heard they'd caught a mild disease from cows, called cowpox.
In 1796, he took fluid from a milkmaid's cowpox blister, and scratched it into the arm of an eight year old boy.
Later, he exposed the boy to smallpox. The boy didn't get sick.
Cow in Latin is vacca. That's where the word vaccine comes from.
In 1980, the world declared smallpox completely wiped out. The first disease ever beaten by vaccines.
